packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and digest updates, grouped into one weekly PR
The automerge label (what the auto-approve workflow reacts to) goes on patch and digest updates, except dev-kit's and flake inputs': labels can't be removed by a later rule

Never automerge flake inputs: a rev-pinned input gets digest updates for every upstream commit, with no release a stability window could apply to. Own PR, so it doesn't block the patch & digest group's automerge
Minor updates: grouped weekly, reviewed by a human
3-day stability window for patch and minor updates. Digest updates get none since they often lack a release timestamp
10-day stability window for major updates, which are more prone to early regressions
Version updates and lock file refreshes build images and run e2e

Group every opendefensecloud/dev-kit pin (Makefile, flake.nix, GitHub Actions and reusable workflows) into one PR. Never automerged: Renovate can't update flake.lock for the flake input, so the PR needs one commit from a human
Tell dev-kit PRs that change the flake input to run nix flake update dev-kit: only those need the flake.lock commit
prBodyNotes: This PR bumps the dev-kit flake input but not `flake.lock`. Run `nix flake update dev-kit` on this branch and push the result. Until then, CI jobs that check for a clean working tree fail, because `nix develop` rewrites the lock.

packageRules.description: Don't pin digests for the helm version that azure/setup-helm installs: Renovate reads its version input as a github-releases dependency named helm
